What is the ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis code for this patient?

Hospital course:
DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient Name: [Name]
Age: 31
Gender: Female
Admission date: [Date]
Discharge date: [Date]

HOSPITAL COURSE:
The patient was admitted for radical resection of right renal carcinoma after CT scans revealed a solid cystic and low-density foci in the right kidney. The surgery was performed under general anesthesia. The kidney was opened, and a white mass of 4 cm size and fine papilla on the surface of the lump in the right kidney was observed. Postoperative pathology revealed Xp11.2 translocations/TFE3 gene fusions associated with renal cell carcinoma. The patient did not receive any other treatments and tolerated the surgery well.

IMPRESSION:
The patient underwent the successful resection of renal cell carcinoma associated with Xp11.2 translocations/TFE3 gene fusions. A follow-up examination one month after the operation showed no recurrence.

PLAN:
The patient will be monitored for any signs of recurrence of renal cell carcinoma. Further follow-up and imaging studies will be recommended as necessary.

DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS:
The patient should continue her hemodialysis without any changes. The patient should make sure to attend all scheduled follow-up appointments and imaging studies. Any unusual symptoms should be reported to their primary care physician immediately.
DISCHARGE DIAGNOSIS: [diagnosis section withheld]
DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
None.

DISCHARGE DISPOSITION:
The patient was discharged in stable condition.

text:
**Principal diagnosis: C64 – Malignant neoplasm of kidney, except renal pelvis**

**Rationale**
- The patient was admitted for, and underwent, radical resection of a right renal tumour. Histopathology confirmed renal cell carcinoma with Xp11.2 translocation/TFE3 gene fusion, so this is the condition chiefly responsible for the admission.
- The tumour arose in the renal parenchyma, not the renal pelvis, so C64 applies rather than C65.
- In ICD-10-AM, C64 is a complete three-character code. Unlike ICD-10-CM (C64.1 for right kidney), it has no laterality extension.

**Associated codes to consider**
- **Morphology:** M8311/3, renal cell carcinoma (Xp11.2 translocation/TFE3 fusion RCC falls within the MiT family translocation carcinomas).
- **Procedure (ACHI):** radical nephrectomy, unilateral, e.g. 36516-01 (open approach). Confirm the approach from the operation report.
- **Additional diagnoses:** the discharge instructions say to continue hemodialysis. If documentation supports it, consider N18.5 (chronic kidney disease, stage 5) and Z99.2 (dependence on renal dialysis), as these would meet additional diagnosis criteria by affecting care during the admission.

Please verify the codes against your current ICD-10-AM/ACHI edition and the Australian Coding Standards.
